notes.title: Ne no Kami: The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto is now available in Chinese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25881614/d75134089b51da544bedc0f430a4dd008feabbb2.png[/img]
Along with the Winter Sale that's under way, we're pleased to announce that part one of the Ne no Kami series is now available in Simplified Chinese! A big thanks to all our Chinese users who expressed interest in this localization!

If you've already purchased the game, all you need to do is go in to your library, right click Ne no Kami, then click on Properties. Under the Languages tab, select Simplified Chinese from the dropdown menu and the download should begin right away. If you're on the fence about picking up the game, it's now on sale for 65% off so don't miss out on this opportunity!

notes.title: Artbook DLC now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25881614/66da99cb7dbc104bfb2700c54a001f6044881996.png[/img]
The artbook for the Ne no Kami series is now live! We highly recommend that fans of the series check it out! This artbook contains explicit and uncensored content so please keep that in mind! Save 10% when you make your purchase before June 14th.

[i]Ne no Kami - The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Artbook contains illustrations, design work and other information about the Ne no Kami universe. Featuring the designs of character designer, Hatachi, dive into the lore of this yuri franchise.[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 72 pages of content including over 30 pages in full color.
[*] Includes a mini manga illustrated by bokkun
[*] Includes a mini light novel featuring characters from the franchise
[/list]

notes.title: Original Soundtrack Now Available
notes.notes:
The OST for Ne No Kami is now available as DLC here on Steam! You can pick it up at https://store.steampowered.com/app/911080/Ne_no_Kami__The_Two_Princess_Knights_of_Kyoto_Original_Soundtrack/

In addition to the game's background music, this release also includes the game's theme song and a special new arrangement of one of the songs by Emmanuel Lagumbay.

If you backed for the OST key on IndieGoGo, please check your email for a message from Backerkit containing your download code.

notes.title: Ne no Kami Part 2 now available!
notes.notes:
Dear yuri lovers and backers, Ne no Kami part 2 is finally available for all on Steam! As some noticed, the release of the game was delayed by a few days on the Steam platform. This was due to a small graphical error that was noticed last minute that had to be fixed, and as such we have been working almost day and night to make sure it would not go for longer than a week before everyone could enjoy the climax to the incredible story of Ne no Kami! We do deeply apologize for the few days some of you had to wait, but we hope it is all worth it as you finally sit down and play the continuation of fenrir vier's well crafted adventure.

Please enjoy part 2 of Ne no Kami and check back for more news on trading cards and more content soon!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/701420/Ne_no_Kami__The_Two_Princess_Knights_of_Kyoto_Part_2/]Ne no Kami - The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Part 2[/url]
